description: This file contains utility functions and core logic for aggregating and flattening telemetry data points in a real-time vehicle monitoring system. It provides functions to bucket timestamped readings, compute percentiles, and produce aggregated telemetry points, which are essential for analyzing time-series sensor data.

classes.name: _AggKey
classes.description: Immutable key class used for identifying data buckets by timestamp and key

methods.name: datetime _ensure_utc(dt: datetime)
methods.description: Normalize a datetime to timezone-aware UTC

methods.name: datetime _bucket_start(ts: datetime, interval_s: int)
methods.description: Calculate the start time of a bucket for a given timestamp based on interval

methods.name: float|None _safe_float(v: Any)
methods.description: Convert a value to float if possible, else return None

methods.name: float _percentile(values: list[float], p: float)
methods.description: Compute the specified percentile of a list of floats

methods.name: list[TelemetryPoint] aggregate_telemetry_points( records: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], agg: TelemetryAgg, interval_s: int, )
methods.description: Aggregate telemetry records into bucketed TelemetryPoint objects based on specified aggregation method

methods.name: list[TelemetryPoint] flatten_raw_telemetry_points(records: Iterable[dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Flatten telemetry data into a list of non-aggregated TelemetryPoints for raw data representation

ctags.name: aggregate_telemetry_points
ctags.signature: ( records: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], agg: TelemetryAgg, interval_s: int, )
